title: 第661章 初次移植第660章 知晓术名
slug: 巫师开局获得传承之一
lines: 贝维克的烙印需要血族当场施术，而自己在发狂前有接触过的血族，也就那复生的“索塔迪亚”
想到这里，修斯眼底骤然一冷。
不久后，他重新看向了躺在台上的巫师。
对方的状态可不太好，虽然表面上看不出什么异常，但其散发的精神力波动已出现了凌乱。
这也是活物被施了搜魂术后必然产生的的副作用。
毕竟搜魂术可是死灵派系的巫术，本就是作用于死物残魂的巫术，而非鲜活的生灵。
如果不是自身的死灵亲和度有三等，他根本不会选择用这方法来搜寻线索。
但好在，对方还活着，这就够了。
很快，修斯便重新接过了毒妖先生递来的器具，开始了鲛人血脉的移植。
血脉移植的第一步，便是抽掉移植对象本身的象征之血。
虽然在生物改造里，移植50%的象征之血便算移植成功。
但修斯的目的，是为了让对方能够代替配方里的鲛人材料，所以他必须给对方移植60%的鲛人之血。
因此，他现在必须抽走对方自身60%的象征之血，而如此一来难度无疑会更大……
随即，修斯便释放出了自己的精神力，将其迅速笼罩在了移植对象的身上。
同时，他又从中再凝起几缕，探入了对方的血管里。
象征之血的形态与血液无异，所以要想寻找，便需要用精神力细细探查。
而那些蕴含着对方本源特性、感知里就如同对方本人的血液，便是他要找的象征之血。
而好在，早已“锻炼”
过精神力的修斯，在进行这一步时格外的顺利。
在他的操控下，数条细如发丝的精神力在对方的血管里灵活游走，不断标记着探查到的象征之血。
约莫五个小时，他便标记完了对方体内所有的象征之血。
当然，这里面自然会有些偏差，可能并不是100%，而是在99%左右浮动。
不过，误差只需保持在2%里便可，因此他可以进行接下来的放血步骤。
下一刻，一旁的毒妖先生便递来了一支造型精致的小瓶子。
修斯伸手接过，随即便一手持瓶、一手握刀地缓步凑向了眼前的移植对象。
精神力笼罩下，那些已被标记的象征之血的流动轨迹，在他的感知里根本无所遁形。
很快，他便循着其中几滴的流动轨迹，在移植对象的大腿位置精准划了一刀。
刀刃轻易地划开了皮肉与血管，同时那几滴象征之血也迅速流到此处，与鲜血一同流入下方凑来的瓶子里。
“叮咚?叮咚……”
很快，血液便灌满了整个瓶子，那几滴象征之血赫然也在其中。
见状，修斯便迅速地缝合了刚才划开的伤口，止住了血液的流失。
content_en:
Bewick's brand requires the vampire to perform the spell on the spot, and the vampire he had come into contact with before going crazy was the resurrected "Sotadia"
Thinking of this, Hughes's eyes suddenly turned cold.
"..."
Soon after, he looked back at the wizard lying on the stage.
The opponent's condition is not very good. Although there is no abnormality on the surface, the fluctuations in the mental power emitted by him are messy.
This is also an inevitable side effect of a soul-searching operation on a living creature.
After all, soul searching is a necromancy sect's witchcraft. It is a witchcraft that works on the remnant souls of dead things, not living creatures.
If it weren't for his third-level undead affinity, he wouldn't have chosen to use this method to search for clues.
But fortunately, the other party is still alive, and that's enough.
"..."
Soon, Hughes took the instrument handed over by Mr. Poison Demon again and started the transplantation of the Mermaid bloodline.
The first step in blood transplantation is to remove the symbolic blood of the transplant target.
Although in biological modification, transplanting 50% of the symbolic blood is considered a successful transplant.
But Hughes's purpose was to allow the other party to replace the shark material in the formula, so he had to transplant 60% of the shark's blood into the other party.
Therefore, he must now drain 60% of the opponent's symbolic blood, which will undoubtedly make it more difficult...
"Buzz——"
Immediately, Hughes released his spiritual power and quickly enveloped the transplant target.
At the same time, he condensed a few more strands from it and penetrated into the opponent's blood vessels.
The shape of the symbolic blood is the same as that of blood, so if you want to find it, you need to use your mental power to explore it carefully.
And the blood that contains the original characteristics of the other person and feels like the other person himself is the symbolic blood he is looking for.
Fortunately, it has already been "exercised"
Hughes, who had mastered mental strength, performed this step particularly smoothly.
Under his control, several hair-thin spiritual powers roamed flexibly in the opponent's blood vessels, constantly marking the detected symbolic blood.
In about five hours, he had marked all the symbolic blood in the opponent's body.
Of course, there will naturally be some deviations here, which may not be 100%, but fluctuate around 99%.
However, the error only needs to be kept within 2%, so he can proceed with the next bloodletting step.
"Da——"
The next moment, Mr. Poison Demon next to him handed over a small bottle with an exquisite shape.
Hughes reached out to take it, then slowly approached the transplant target in front of him, holding a bottle in one hand and a knife in the other.
Under the shroud of spiritual power, the flow path of the marked symbolic blood was completely invisible to his perception.
Soon, he followed the flow of a few drops and made a precise cut on the thigh of the transplant recipient.
"Chila——"
The blade easily cut through the flesh and blood vessels, and at the same time, the few drops of symbolic blood quickly flowed here, and flowed into the bottle below with the blood.
"Ding dong? Ding dong..."
Soon, the blood filled the entire bottle, and the few drops of symbolic blood were among them.
Seeing this, Hughes quickly sewed up the wound he had just opened to stop the blood loss.
